assets.name: 大型保险箱
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE new original world-container sprite for 潮汐线, an original muted late-20th-century salvage survival game. Image1 is existing SMALL safe for family/style reference ONLY; image2 is existing container style reference; image3 defines high-angle camera. Create a distinctly different LARGE HEAVY SAFE. One intact closed upright squat steel safe, broad square dominant dark graphite/grey-green TOP, thick chamfered steel case, heavy recessed SOUTH-facing front door with a clearly readable tiny round brass/steel locking wheel, thick door frame, two chunky right-side hinges and short solid base. Main colors muted graphite, steel grey, subdued olive-green, a few dull brass accents. It should fill more of its logical tile than the small safe and look substantially heavier and more valuable through its silhouette and door thickness, not through bright color or a rarity badge. Camera precisely75degrees above horizontal (15 off straight down), orthographic, aligned square-grid, top surface dominates about65-70%, short south face about30-35%, right edge darker, fixed upper-left light. NO diamond isometric angle or frontal product shot. Authentic coarse32x32 pixel-art asset with hard square clusters, around12-15 colors, no soft rendering, no dense realistic noise. Entire object within logical28x28 area on32x32 transparent canvas, >=2px clear border, foot at logicaly28. Genuine transparent background, no ground tile, cast shadow, scene, glowing effects, text, labels, UI, rarity markers, open door or contents. Draw only ONE safe, no contact sheet. Output will be nearest-neighbor sampled to32px.
assets.processing: alpha crop; nearest-neighbour contain; binary alpha; 16-color quantization
